nodes.label: Incident custom resource
nodes.rationale: One alert in alert-triage; the coordinator owns its status (Pending, Triaging, Done, Failed).

nodes.label: TriageRun custom resource
nodes.rationale: One triage step in agent-sandboxes; the coordinator writes its spec and the triage controller writes its status.

nodes.label: Report size limit in etcd
nodes.rationale: Reports live in TriageRun status and count against etcd object size, so they are capped at 256 KiB.

nodes.label: Single writer per field
nodes.rationale: Each CR field has exactly one writer, so the coordinator and triage controller never conflict on the same field.

nodes.label: Coordinator runs as separate process
nodes.rationale: Keeps RBAC-write permission out of the webhook and agent API processes, which are the least trusted callers.

nodes.label: Triage controller RBAC-write risk
nodes.rationale: A module inside the triage controller would let a webhook or agent API compromise hold RBAC-write permission.

nodes.label: Human approval of scale actions
nodes.rationale: Restarts run at once; scaling waits for spec.approval set to Approved

nodes.label: Local LLM mode
nodes.rationale: LLM_MODE=local with PROFILE=lean routes to an OpenAI-compatible local server

nodes.label: REMEDIATION_MODE
nodes.rationale: dry-run records actions without doing them; off rejects all

nodes.label: Alert triage flow
nodes.rationale: SigNoz alert to Incident to TriageRun to sandbox report

nodes.label: docs/architecture.md
nodes.rationale: Required reading before changing sandbox, runtime class, or MCP wiring

nodes.label: Working agreements
nodes.rationale: Read architecture first, ADRs for hard-to-reverse decisions, docs in same change, no secrets

nodes.label: Coordinator setup checks
nodes.rationale: coordinator step verifies RBAC, admission policy, run identity isolation, token revocation

nodes.label: End-to-end check
nodes.rationale: Demo run: alert fires, sandbox created and deleted, remediation expected NoAction

nodes.label: k8s-infra collectors step
nodes.rationale: OTel agent and deployment collectors export to SigNoz ingester

nodes.label: Remediation RBAC checks
nodes.rationale: Executor and remediation identity RBAC limited to one action on one target

nodes.label: Remediation setup step
nodes.rationale: Opens REMEDIATION_NAMESPACES, installs starter RemediationSkill, sets REMEDIATION_MODE

nodes.label: SigNoz alert rule step
nodes.rationale: Creates triage-webhook channel and K8s warning events rule

nodes.label: Coordinator
nodes.rationale: Moves Incidents through steps and creates per-step ServiceAccount identities

nodes.label: Egress allowlist
nodes.rationale: Per-workload egress rules; only egress-gateway reaches the internet on 443

nodes.label: Repository layout
nodes.rationale: Maps api, cmd, internal, skills, deploy, docs directories

nodes.label: Remediation step
nodes.rationale: Second sandboxed agent proposes one restart or scale action or declines

nodes.label: Remediation executor
nodes.rationale: Checks skill and RBAC, approval, cooldown, then restarts or scales

nodes.label: Report review
nodes.rationale: Rejects reports with uncalled tools or invented URLs, then sets incomplete after two rejections

nodes.label: slack-sink
nodes.rationale: In-cluster stand-in for a Slack webhook, shows reports on a web page

nodes.label: Triage controller
nodes.rationale: Webhook receiver, runs sandboxes, agent API, remediation executor

nodes.label: Triage sandbox under gVisor
nodes.rationale: Runs triage-agent with its own ServiceAccount and no internet access

nodes.label: ADR recording rule
nodes.rationale: Hard-to-reverse decisions go in docs/adr using 0000-template.md

nodes.label: coordinator-grantable ClusterRole
nodes.rationale: Grantable ceiling bound only in agent-sandboxes, with no escalate or bind verbs

nodes.label: Incident and TriageRun custom resources
nodes.rationale: Run state moved from triage controller memory into CRs with one writer per field

nodes.label: coordinator-step-identities ValidatingAdmissionPolicy
nodes.rationale: Guard mirrored in Go by Identity.Allowed

nodes.label: TriageRun suspend-then-resume ordering
nodes.rationale: TriageRun is created suspended, identity is created, then the run is resumed; the triage controller ignores suspended runs

nodes.label: Approval policy (auto or required)
nodes.rationale: restart-pod and rollout-restart auto; scale and open-pr require approval; skills may override

nodes.label: Per-remediation-run least-privilege identity
nodes.rationale: ServiceAccount and Role generated from skill actions with resourceNames pinned to the alert target

nodes.label: Modular monolith module layout
nodes.rationale: Modules talk through consumer-defined interfaces; only internal/remediation/actions holds write clients

nodes.label: open-pr driver (deferred)
nodes.rationale: Dry-run driver first, GitHub driver later

nodes.label: Namespace-scoped workload write Role
nodes.rationale: One Role per opened namespace (delete pods, patch workloads, update scale); no cluster-wide write

nodes.label: Approval Gate
nodes.rationale: Human approval required for scale and open-pr by default; can be overridden per skill.

nodes.label: Per-target Cooldown
nodes.rationale: REMEDIATION_COOLDOWN limit between actions on the same target.

nodes.label: Coordinator
nodes.rationale: Separate process that is the only creator of RBAC objects and moves incidents through steps.

nodes.label: Egress Gateway
nodes.rationale: Envoy proxy and the only pod allowed to reach the internet, limited to two hosts.

nodes.label: gVisor RuntimeClass
nodes.rationale: RuntimeClass gvisor mapping pods to the runsc user-space kernel.

nodes.label: Incident
nodes.rationale: Custom resource created per deduplicated alert; holds run state.

nodes.label: k8s-infra OTel Collectors
nodes.rationale: otel-agent DaemonSet and otel-deployment that ship cluster telemetry to SigNoz.

nodes.label: K8s Read-Only MCP Server
nodes.rationale: Cluster inspection tools backed by a get/list/watch ServiceAccount with no Secrets access.

nodes.label: Remediation Kill Switch
nodes.rationale: REMEDIATION_MODE with values live, dry-run or off.

nodes.label: llm-proxy
nodes.rationale: Holds the Anthropic key and enforces model allowlist and max_tokens cap for agents.

nodes.label: NetworkPolicy (Calico)
nodes.rationale: Restricts sandbox traffic to controller, MCP servers, llm-proxy and DNS.

nodes.label: Remediation Agent
nodes.rationale: Same image as the triage agent in AGENT_MODE=remediate; proposes at most one action.

nodes.label: Remediation Executor
nodes.rationale: Runs Remediations inside the triage controller and is the only code with workload write access.

nodes.label: Remediation
nodes.rationale: Custom resource for one remediation step, carrying a copy of the chosen skill and target.

nodes.label: RemediationSkill
nodes.rationale: Cluster-scoped policy that matches alerts and allows specific actions on specific namespaces.

nodes.label: Triage Sandbox Pod
nodes.rationale: gVisor pod in namespace agent-sandboxes hosting an agent with a memory-backed scratchpad.

nodes.label: SigNoz
nodes.rationale: Stores logs, traces and metrics in ClickHouse, evaluates alert rules and calls the webhook.

nodes.label: SigNoz MCP Server
nodes.rationale: Exposes alerts, logs, traces and metrics as read tools using a Viewer-role API key.

nodes.label: Step Identity (SA, Role, RoleBinding)
nodes.rationale: Per-step ServiceAccount and RBAC named triage-run or remediate-incident, deleted when the step ends.

nodes.label: Triage Agent
nodes.rationale: Read-only LLM agent inside the sandbox that gathers evidence through MCP tools and submits a report.

nodes.label: Triage Controller
nodes.rationale: Go webhook receiver that records Incidents, runs TriageRuns and posts reports; only component allowed to reach chat tools.

nodes.label: TriageRun
nodes.rationale: Custom resource for one triage step; stores the report in its status.

nodes.label: coordinator-step-identities Policy
nodes.rationale: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy rejecting RBAC objects that are not step-shaped.

nodes.label: Coordinator for step order and per-step identity
nodes.norm_label: coordinator for step order and per-step identity

nodes.label: ADR 0003: remediation executor runs in the triage controller
nodes.norm_label: adr 0003: remediation executor runs in the triage controller
nodes.rationale: Executor is a module of the triage controller, enabled by REMEDIATION_ENABLED, rather than a separate Deployment

nodes.label: Executor in coordinator (rejected alternative)
nodes.rationale: Coordinator already holds RBAC-write; adding workload write would make it the most damaging component to compromise

nodes.label: resourceNames as namespace.name target
nodes.rationale: Target name alone matches the same name in every namespace; namespaces cannot contain dots so the form is unambiguous

nodes.label: Security Model
nodes.rationale: Assumes all agent input is untrusted and limits what a manipulated agent can do.
